---
title: "Metadata schema"
---

This page documents the metadata Fair Data Finder stores on a dataset (STAC
Item) and where it appears. The registration form
(`ItemForm`) is the source of truth for fields written at create/edit time.

## Where metadata lives

| Layer | What you see |
|-------|----------------|
| **Internal (pgSTAC Item)** | Full Item JSON: `id`, `collection`, `geometry`, `bbox`, `properties`, `assets`, `links` |
| **Application API / STAC API** | Same Item JSON via `/api/collections/{id}/items/...` and `/api/search` |
| **STAC core fields** | Standard Item fields (`geometry`, `datetime`, `assets`, …) |
| **FDF-specific properties** | Custom keys under `properties` (for example `projectNumber`, `legalRestrictions`) |
| **Keyword vocabulary** | Managed in `public` tables; a **snapshot** is copied onto `properties.keywords` |

::: {.callout-note}
Keyword definitions can change later in the Keywords tab. Existing Items keep
the keyword objects that were stored when the Item was saved.
:::

## Dataset (Item) metadata

### Identification

| Field | Required for submit | Description |
|-------|---------------------|-------------|
| `collection` | Yes | Parent domain (STAC Collection id) |
| `properties.title` | Yes | Dataset title (UI label: *Project title*) |
| `properties.projectNumber` | No | Optional numeric project number |
| `properties.description` | No | Free-text description |
| `properties.language` | No | Default `eng` |
| `id` | Auto | Generated identifier (nanoid) |

### Temporal information

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `properties.datetime` | Instant in time, or `null` when a range is used |
| `properties.start_datetime` | Start of a temporal range |
| `properties.end_datetime` | End of a temporal range |
| `properties.publication_datetime` | Publication date (date-only ISO string) |

Use either an instant (`datetime`) or a range (`start_datetime` /
`end_datetime`), consistent with STAC temporal conventions.

### Spatial information

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `geometry` | GeoJSON geometry; may be `null` for non-spatial / global datasets |
| `bbox` | Bounding box derived from geometry when present |
| `properties.spatialReferenceSystem` | CRS or “not applicable”; custom values allowed |

### Domains and keywords

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `collection` | Domain membership |
| `properties.facility_type` | Origin type used to filter available keyword groups (`experimentalFacility`, `numericalModel`, `Field`, …) |
| `properties.keywords` | Array of keyword **objects** selected at registration (`id`, `nl_keyword`, `en_keyword`, …) |

Search filters domains via the Collection and keywords via
`properties.keywords.id` (CQL2 `a_overlaps`).

### Data access and legal

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `assets` | Map of assets: `title`, `description`, `href`, `type` (optional `roles` when present) |
| `properties.legalRestrictions` | Restriction code (default `license`) |
| `properties.restrictionsOfUse` | Free-text use restrictions |

Collection-level `license` is set to `proprietary` when Domains are created
in the UI.

### Originators and quality

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `properties.originatorDataOrganisation` | Default `Deltares` |
| `properties.originatorDataEmail` | Optional |
| `properties.originatorMetaDataOrganisation` | Default `Deltares` |
| `properties.originatorMetaDataEmail` | Optional |
| `properties.dataQualityInfoStatement` | Free text |

### Fields sometimes present but not set by the registration form

These may appear on Items (for example from older data or other writers) and
are shown or searched when present:

| Field | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| `properties.providers` | Shown on the item detail page if present |
| `properties.updated` / `properties.created` | Shown on the item detail page if present |
| `properties.license`, `metadataStandardName`, `progressCode` | Included in full-text search matching if present |
| `properties.storagelocation` | Shown as a column on the Register list; the form stores access links in **assets** |

The UI may set a client-only flag `globaldataset` when `geometry` is `null`;
that flag is for display in Search, not a persisted registration field.

## Domain (Collection) metadata

When a Data Steward creates a domain, Fair Data Finder writes a STAC
Collection with:

| Field | Typical value in FDF |
|-------|----------------------|
| `type` | `Collection` |
| `stac_version` | `1.0.0` |
| `id` / `title` | From the domain title |
| `description` | Domain description |
| `keywords` | Often an empty array at Collection level |
| `license` | `proprietary` |
| `extent.spatial.bbox` | Spatial extent |
| `extent.temporal.interval` | Temporal extent |
| `links` | Optional keywords facility link (`rel: "keywords"`) |

## Summary: internal vs API vs STAC

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
  subgraph public_schema [public schema]
    Fac[Facility / Keyword tables]
    Users[Users / Groups / Roles]
  end
  subgraph pgstac [pgstac schema]
    Col[Collection = Domain]
    It[Item = Dataset]
  end
  Fac -.->|link on Collection| Col
  Fac -->|snapshot on save| It
  Col --> It
  It -->|GET/POST /api/search<br/>/api/collections/.../items| API[STAC API JSON]
```

- **Internally:** vocabularies and RBAC in `public`; domains/datasets in `pgstac`.
- **Through the API:** Collections and Items are standard STAC JSON (plus FDF
  properties under `properties`).
- **Through STAC concepts:** Domain = Collection, Dataset = Item, access
  links = Assets. See [STAC](stac.qmd).
